*   *   *   * Copied!

**Devin Bush  
Linebacker  
Michigan  
5-11, 234  
Pembroke Pines, Fla.  
Flanagan High School  
1st Round â 10th Overall**

**CAREER NOTES**  
Played in 39 games, 32 starts, at Michigan as a three-year lettermanâ¦a two-time Academic All-Big Ten Conference member (2017-18)â¦registered 194 tackles, 20.0 tackles for losses, 10.0 sacks, one interception and 17 passes defensed in his Wolverines career.

**2018 SEASON**  
NCAA Consensus All-American, earning All-Big Ten first-team honorsâ¦Nagurski-Woodson Big Ten Defensive Player of the Year and a Butkus-Fitzgerald Big Ten Linebacker of the Year recipientâ¦Roger Zatkoff Award winner as Michigan's top linebackerâ¦voted a team captainâ¦started all 12 games, leading the team with 80 tackles, 9.5 stops for loss, 5.0 sacks and six pass breakupsâ¦led Michigan with nine tackles, 2.5 stops for loss and a sack vs. Nebraska (Sept. 22)â¦matched a career-high and led the defense with 12 tackles, 1.0 stop for a loss and a half-sack against Indiana (Nov. 17).

**2017 SEASON**  
Roger Zatkoff Award â school's most outstanding linebacker â recipient, Academic All-Big Ten, Walter Camp Football Foundation All-America second-teamâ¦led the defense with 102 tackles, including 9.5 stops for losses, 5.0 sacks, one interception and nine pass breakups playing in and starting all 13 gamesâ¦recorded a sack in each of the first four gamesâ¦made his first collegiate start vs. Florida (Sept. 2), amassing seven tackles, 2.5 stops for loss and 1.5 sacksâ¦made a career-high 12 tackles with seven solo tackles and a sack vs. Air Force (Sept. 16)â¦led the defense with 11 tackles vs. Rutgers (Oct. 28), including two tackles for loss and a half-sackâ¦posted eight tackles against South Carolina in the Outback Bowl (Jan. 1).

**2016 SEASON**  
Earned his first varsity letter playing in all 13 games on special teams and at linebacker in seven gamesâ¦contributed 12 tackles and an assisted tackle for a lossâ¦made collegiate debut vs. Hawaii (Sept. 3), playing linebacker and on special teams.

**HIGH SCHOOL**  
Played at Flanagan (Pembroke Pines, Fla.) High Schoolâ¦helped guide the team to the FHSAA Class 8A state championship in 2015, recording 67 tackles, nine tackles for loss and 1.5 sacks as a seniorâ¦posted 67 tackles and 4.5 sacks in 10 games played as a juniorâ¦totaled 114 tackles, 2.0 sacks and three interceptions as a sophomoreâ¦recorded 80 tackles in freshman campaignâ¦Butkus High School Award semifinalistâ¦father, Devin Bush, Sr., played at Florida State and was a member of the Super Bowl XXXIV St. Louis Rams championship team.
